Launch an interactive agent session that runs three debug jobs end-to-end.

The session receives full project context (CLAUDE.md, RULES.md, LEARNINGS.md)
and follows the debug workflow (diagnose → fix → present recommendations):
  - Diagnose: Identify the root cause of the failure and collect the signals needed to reproduce it.
  - Fix: Apply the most direct code or configuration correction, verify it, and capture the resulting learnings.
  - Present recommendations: Propose systemic changes, process updates, or rule tweaks that prevent recurrence.

Examples:
  gromit debug                              # Blank session
  gromit debug "login fails with + in email" # Pre-seeded description
  gromit debug --model sonnet "API returns 500" # Override model
  gromit debug --agent codex "Cache miss flapping" # Use Codex agent
